game enhancement mod.name: Game Enhancement Mod
game enhancement mod.description: Adds object and route hints, extended creature information, town controls, army and artifact shortcuts, and optional spell research. Features depend on GEM settings and the installed plugins.

0.name: Object labels
0.description: Hold Alt to show supported map-object labels when adventure hints are enabled.

1.name: Route movement cost
1.description: Show required and remaining movement points for the selected hero.

2.name: Separate map-object hint
2.description: Show the object hint in a message when supported by the hint script.

3.name: Load without confirmation
3.description: gem_scripts.erm opens the load-game screen directly.

4.name: Additional town menu
4.description: Default key code 192; configurable in gem_settings.town_menu.dlg_run_bttn.

5.name: Quick creature upgrade
5.description: Use on creature stacks or hero armies; requires fast upgrade stacks in town.dll.

6.name: Upgrade cost hint
6.description: Hold A over the supported town troop or hero item to preview the upgrade cost.

7.name: Wait with all troops
7.description: Apply waiting to the local human army for this round. Disabled during Tactics; multiplayer battles may request confirmation.

8.name: Defend with all troops
8.description: Apply defence to the local human army for this round. Disabled during Tactics; multiplayer battles may request confirmation.

9.name: Quick artifact picker
9.description: List compatible artifacts from this hero's backpack for the clicked equipment slot. Requires Interface_ArtifactsQuickSwitching.era; can override HD Shift-click transfer.

10.name: Quick artifact picker
10.description: Open the same equipment picker with the middle mouse button.

11.name: Meeting: Quick artifact picker
11.description: List compatible artifacts from this hero's backpack for the clicked equipment slot. Requires Interface_ArtifactsQuickSwitching.era; can override HD Shift-click transfer.

12.name: Meeting: Quick artifact picker
12.description: Open the same equipment picker with the middle mouse button.

13.name: Dialog: confirm
13.description: The gameplay features module adds Space to supported OK buttons.

14.name: Numeric input with Num Lock
14.description: The gameplay features module maps the numeric keypad to digits while Num Lock is on.

15.name: GEM settings
15.description: Open the GEM settings menu on the adventure map.
